title: Contract changes cascade staleness downstream
context: Alternative approaches: no cascade; require manual re-review everywhere; ignore contract changes.
decision: A contract change (signature, params, returns, errors on a contract-method facet, or export list on a service) drops every node with an inbound `depends_on` edge from `accepted` to `stale`. Human re-review is the only way to resolve staleness.
consequences: Dependents are automatically marked for review when their dependencies change; breaking changes surface immediately; the stale node draws a caption naming the changed member and time; teams cannot ignore breaking changes.
